# Antigravity Run Ledger MCP

Paid remote MCP for Antigravity agent run receipt MCP, structured receipts, audit logs, and reviewer-ready evidence.

Website: https://antigravityrunledger.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://antigravityrunledger.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://antigravityrunledger.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/antigravity-run-ledger-mcp

Use case: Antigravity agent run receipt MCP with structured receipts.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: issue_run_receipt, summarize_agent_changes, check_test_evidence, flag_review_risk, export_run_log
